mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, user_code, flow_no, earn_time, points, reason, expire_time, used_points, available_points, is_used_up, point_source_type, source_no, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM points_earn_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND user_code = #{userCode} AND available_points > 0 ORDER BY expire_time ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) FROM points_earn_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND source_no = #{sourceNo} AND point_source_type = 'REFUND'

SELECT id, tenant_code, user_code, flow_no, earn_time, points, reason, expire_time, used_points, available_points, is_used_up, point_source_type, source_no, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM points_earn_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND expire_time < #{expireTime} AND available_points > 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE points_earn_record SET used_points = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.usedPoints} END, available_points = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.availablePoints} END, is_used_up = CASE id WHEN #{item.id} THEN #{item.isUsedUp} END, version = version + 1 WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN ( #{item.id} )
